Where does iTop Pools build fiberglass pools?

iTop Pools builds Barrier Reef fiberglass pools across Northeast Florida, including Jacksonville, Ponte Vedra Beach, Nocatee, St. Johns, St. Augustine, Julington Creek, Fleming Island, Orange Park, Mandarin, Jacksonville Beach, Green Cove Springs and Middleburg. The free site visit confirms access, setbacks and permit requirements for your property.

What should you check before building in your area?

  • Building permit. Your city or county reviews the site plan, setbacks, electrical and drainage. Read about permits.
  • HOA review. Many planned communities want drawings and materials before approving. Our 3D design and site plan help with this.
  • Safety feature. Florida law requires new residential pools to have at least one approved safety feature.
  • Access. Narrow lots or pools behind the house may need a crane. See how a shell gets into your yard.
